how_to_requalify.note: Pipe tests spawn their own child BridgeMain JVMs with FORGE_ENGINE_SHA bound; no display, no network. WS216 projection adds library_size and battlefield_details (additive, redacted via view gates).

global_gates.rules_authority: Forge Rules-Core alone determines legality, costs, mana, stack, priority, targets, combat, triggers, layers, SBAs, zones, copy/control and Rules randomness. The bridge never decides.
global_gates.no_second_engine: PASS: all option sets derive from native controller callbacks and Core-owned enumerations; divided allocation has no second model and stays BLOCKED for behavior.
global_gates.no_ai_authority: PASS: every seat pinned to ExternalPlayerController; forge-ai never consulted.
global_gates.no_gui_defaults: PASS: HeadlessGuiFailClosedTest pins choice-bearing GUI entries to throw.
global_gates.no_requested_option_filtering: PASS: per-family exact counts (Expel 11, static 2, hidden subsets, Fleshbag 3, Snort 2, Extinction 2, order 2, etc.) plus wrong-actor/stale/unknown negatives in-process and over pipe.
global_gates.principal_scoping: PASS: actor-only options, foe hands <hidden>, outsider legal_actions empty, pending_decision null for non-actors, WRONG_ACTOR on read and submit, event export fails closed.
global_gates.rng: PASS with single-flight caveat (WS202 twins still green).
global_gates.replay: NOT CLAIMED: export_replay fails closed by design.
global_gates.credit_basis: name-only diff vs audit base outside forge-protocol2-bridge/ is empty; no Forge Rules-Core production edits except additive projection.
